verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for a developer-facing transcription API, so the axis applies. The pack documents modes, parameters, model IDs and endpoints such as /aiservices/assets/vocabularies, but none of it shows a version scheme in the API paths or a published deprecation or sunset policy. Model IDs and the llms.txt or API catalog probes are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.
